'''GBTL Grasim''' (formerly known as Grasim Bhiwani Textile Ltd) is an Indian manufacturing company engaged in the production of polyester-viscose fabric. It was previously a part of [[Grasim Industries]], a flagship company of the [[Aditya Birla Group]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=October 1, 2013 |title=Grasim Bhiwani expects turnover of Rs 750 cr in 3 years |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/grasim-bhiwani-expects-turnover-of-rs-750-cr-in-3-years-113100100894_1.html |work=Business Standard}}</ref>

In 2017, Grasim Bhiwani Textiles was acquired by the Donear Group, a Mumbai-based textile company<ref>{{Cite news |last=Gaur |first=Vatsala |date=2017-07-10 |title=Grasim divests its holding in Grasim Bhiwani Textiles to Donear |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/garments-/-textiles/grasim-divests-its-holding-in-grasim-bhiwani-textiles-to-donear/articleshow/59527035.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-06-18 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=July 11, 2017 |title=Grasim Industries divests Grasim Bhiwani Textiles to Donear group |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/grasim-industries-divests-grasim-bhiwani-textiles-to-donear-group-2322703.html |work=MoneyControl}}</ref> Later that same year, Grasim Bhiwani Textiles signed Bollywood actor [[Amitabh Bachchan]] as its brand ambassador.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ganguly |first=Shramana |date=October 11, 2017 |title=GBTL signs Amitabh Bachchan as Grasim's brand ambassador - ET Retail |url=http://retail.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/apparel-fashion/apparel/gbtl-signs-amitabh-bachchan-as-grasims-brand-ambassador/61022855 |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=ETRetail.com |language=en}}</ref>
